improveModelsHint: Allow your chats and meeting notes to be used to train and improve models. Off by default.
shareLocationHint: Used for local weather and time-aware answers. Only the area is shared, never your exact position.
marketingHint: Occasional emails about new features. Account emails come anyway.
crossBorderHint: Your data stays in Russia, and Leo processes it in the EU. Without this consent Leo and the other AI features stop working.
crossBorderWarningTitle: Withdraw consent to processing in the EU?
crossBorderWarning: Leo, transcription and every other AI feature stop working for your account until you give it again. Your data stays where it is.
dontKeepMeetingsHint: You see the transcript during a meeting, but nothing stays after it: no transcript, Leo’s notes or recording. Minutes still count, and recordings can’t be uploaded.
dontKeepMeetingsConfirm: Meetings you start from now on won’t be kept: afterwards there’s no transcript, Leo’s notes or recording, Leo won’t remember them, and there’s nothing to share. Meetings already saved stay.
exportHint: A copy of everything Shosai keeps about you, as one archive. It’s also emailed to you when ready.
exportFailed: Couldn’t prepare the archive. Try again.
